name: chess_checkmate_in_one_big_bench
description:
Dataset Card for BIG-Bench Checkmate In One Move
	



This is an adapted version of the BIG-Bench Checkmate in One Move task originally made by Nitish Keskar (nkeskar@salesforce.com).
There also exists a dataset with the image representation of the board positions before the checkmate move.
The original task description is the following:

The goal of this task is to probe the ability of language models to play chess in standard algebraic notation (SAN). The input to the model is a… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/alonsosilva/chess_checkmate_in_one_big_bench.
reputation: Part of the BIG-Bench suite; commonly used as a probe of models' chess/move-generation and reasoning abilities.
